answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer stadium map styled as a modern World Cup venue, centered on a compact arcade-sized regulation-style pitch with two goals and a goalkeeper positioned at each goal. Full spectator stands tightly surround the field, packed with a large crowd and decorated with national flags representing the selectable teams. At the spawn area, place a World Cup-style trophy as the central landmark, with a nearby shop building or kiosk. Include a finals presentation area featuring Spanish flags and a Spain 2026 winner display.
agent_notes: Eleven-a-side matches with a goalkeeper, goals and a knockout bracket are Sports, so the pitch takes space-bounded and the Field Sport preset; the answers add a compact arcade pitch inside a real modern World Cup venue with full stands, which brings in barrier-perimeter, spectator-bleachers for the tiered seating and npc-population for the cheering crowd. Party & Casual is named second because the spawn field where players gather between bracket rounds to pick a flag and shop is its social-hub, and nothing in Sports can express a lobby — the shape, preset and route all stay with Sports. I kept the match and the lobby on one continuous surface rather than taking space-staged: the prompt never asks for the pitch to be hidden from spawn, and that shape would cost P4 for nothing. The trophy at the centre of spawn and the shop front are real geometry that no loaded option row covers, so they ride along as free-text image detail; the penalty shootout is played on the same pitch and needs no separate space.
